rows.headline: SEBI bars Copthall Mauritius, Mansi Share and Stock Broking from markets over Sensex closing-auction manipulation, impounds Rs 3.68 crore
rows.prelim_note: SEBI ex-parte interim order finds Copthall (99.91%/96.09%/85.21% of buy-order value in three CAS spikes) and Mansi (aggressive then-cancelled sell orders) drove three sharp Sensex CAS moves on Aug 13 expiry day tied to options positions; Rs 2.96cr + Rs 0.72cr wrongful gains impounded, both barred from securities markets - regulatory/legal risk to market integrity (materiality criterion: regulatory/legal risk).

rows.headline: Korean and Japanese chip stocks plunge as bond-yield spike hits Samsung, SK Hynix; Kospi triggers circuit breaker
rows.prelim_note: Kospi fell 5.8% (index futures -6.02% triggered a 5-min sell-order suspension) and Nikkei fell 3.2%; Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix each fell roughly 8-9.8%, Kioxia -12.6%, Furukawa Electric -13.7%, on a Philadelphia semiconductor index rout plus surging global bond yields - supply/demand and estimate-impact risk for named chipmakers (materiality criterion: supply/demand dynamics, shift analyst expectations).

rows.headline: US Treasury to double long-bond buybacks; gold jumps to two-month high as yields tumble
rows.prelim_note: Treasury Secretary Bessent announced doubling the size of buyback operations for 10-30yr securities; 30-year yield fell over 8bp to 5.20%, 10-year fell ~5bp to 4.66%, and gold rose to ~$4,480-4,493/oz (+3.66% on the day), highest since early June - macro/rates driver for duration-sensitive and gold-linked names (materiality criterion: supply/demand dynamics via financing-cost transmission).

rows.headline: Ameresco CFO Mark Chiplock resigns effective September 25, 2026
rows.prelim_note: 8-K filed disclosing CFO Mark Chiplock's resignation (not tied to any disagreement over operations, policy or practice, per the filing) to take a CFO role at a private-equity-owned company; company has commenced a CFO search - management-credibility signal (materiality criterion: affect management credibility).

rows.headline: D.A. Davidson upgrades Duolingo to Buy, raises price target to $160 from $130; shares jump 7%
rows.prelim_note: D.A. Davidson analyst Wyatt Swanson upgraded DUOL to Buy from Neutral citing product, marketing and monetization improvements undervalued by the market, against a broader analyst base still mostly hold-or-worse (21 of 25); shares rose 7% - shifts estimate/valuation view against a skeptical consensus (materiality criterion: shift analyst expectations).
